note: Scaled from the three natural videos paper_720p_* to 320x240 and burned in frame number labels; the label area does not overlap the valid area for quality evaluation (top 160 rows); the filter graph is identical word for word to scripts/alphartc/generate_labeled_source.py, except the input is headless raw YUV so input parameters were added

low.ffmpeg: ffmpeg -y -v error -f rawvideo -pix_fmt yuv420p -s 1280x720 -r 15 -i /path/to/alphartc/LLM4Band/testmedia/paper_720p_low.yuv -vf fps=15,scale=320:240,drawbox=x=0:y=160:w=iw:h=ih-160:color=black@1:t=fill,drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf:text='%{eif\:n+1\:d\:6}':fontcolor=white:fontsize=52:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=170 -frames:v 630 -pix_fmt yuv420p -f rawvideo /path/to/alphartc/LLM4Band/testmedia/qoe_labeled_low_320x240.yuv

medium.ffmpeg: ffmpeg -y -v error -f rawvideo -pix_fmt yuv420p -s 1280x720 -r 15 -i /path/to/alphartc/LLM4Band/testmedia/paper_720p_medium.yuv -vf fps=15,scale=320:240,drawbox=x=0:y=160:w=iw:h=ih-160:color=black@1:t=fill,drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf:text='%{eif\:n+1\:d\:6}':fontcolor=white:fontsize=52:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=170 -frames:v 630 -pix_fmt yuv420p -f rawvideo /path/to/alphartc/LLM4Band/testmedia/qoe_labeled_medium_320x240.yuv
